comment: Route id -> OSM hiking relation id, confirmed by hand. The tool proposes candidates in data/route-lines-report.md and refuses to promote any of them on its own: a title containing a relation's name is a question, and this file is the only answer. 'Devil's Peak contour paths' contains 'Contour Path' and is NOT that relation.

rejected.cape-country--winelands--jonkershoek--di: Proposed relation 6198096 is Table Mountain's Diagonal Route. This is a different route in Jonkershoek sharing a word.
rejected.table-mountain--newlands-east--skeleton-: Proposed relation 7057849 is Nursery Ravine alone. The route is 'Nursery Ravine and Skeleton Gorge' — the relation is half of it, so its line would end where the route does not.

table-mountain--front-face-north--platte.note: The same ascent. The route title carries a site suffix; the relation is the gorge itself.

table-mountain--atlantic-west--kasteelsp.note: The KP path the guide describes, end to end.

table-mountain--atlantic-west--corridor-.note: Exact name. The other candidate (19470956) is a longer combination route that merely passes through.

table-mountain--atlantic-west--diagonal-.note: Exact name, on Table Mountain. Not to be confused with the Jonkershoek route of a similar name — see rejected.

table-mountain--atlantic-west--wood-ravi.note: Wood Ravine, aka Woody Ravine in the guide.

table-mountain--devils-peak--mobray-ridg.note: Exact name. The other candidate (18187101) is a longer traverse that includes this ridge as one leg.

table-mountain--newlands-east--newlands-.note: Exact name, the ravine the guide describes.

cape-country--garden-route-little-karoo-.note: Exact name. Outside the shipped Cape Town region, so it will not draw today, but the claim is true.

table-mountain--front-face-north--india-.note: JUDGEMENT CALL, confirmed on the user's instruction to include the uncertain three. The guide's 'India Venster B' is a variation start on the India Venster path the relation describes; the relation's extent is the main line.

table-mountain--front-face-north--kloof-.note: JUDGEMENT CALL, confirmed on the user's instruction. The guide calls it Kloof Corner Ridge; the relation is Kloof Corner. Same corner of the mountain, and the relation is the path up it.

peninsula--hout-bay--twelve-apostles-pat.note: JUDGEMENT CALL, confirmed on the user's instruction. The relation is named Apostles Path and the route Twelve Apostles Path; they are the same traverse along the Apostles.
